claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place on Monday, April 13, 2026.
The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place at 7 p.m. ET.
The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City.
The 2026 WNBA Draft will be broadcast live on ESPN.
The 2026 WNBA Draft will be streamed on the ESPN App.
Streaming options for the 2026 WNBA Draft include fuboTV.
Streaming options for the 2026 WNBA Draft include Watch ESPN.
ESPN Deportes provides the Spanish broadcast for the 2026 WNBA Draft.
SiriusXM NBA Radio provides radio or audio coverage for the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Orange Carpet Special starts at 5:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2.
WNBA Countdown starts at 6:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
The 2026 WNBA Draft is presented by State Street Investment Management SPY.
The Dallas Wings hold the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
